title: Sort Colors
constraints: Rearrange the same array without calling a library sort.

examples.explanation: The three categories must be contiguous in 0, 1, 2 order.

solutionApproaches.title: Count Then Overwrite
solutionApproaches.explanation: Count zeroes, ones, and twos, then overwrite the array in three runs; valid but not the one-pass follow-up.

solutionApproaches.title: Dutch National Flag (Three Pointers)
solutionApproaches.explanation: Maintain low, mid, high pointers. Swap 0s to the left, 2s to the right, advance mid for 1s.
